A smooth projective complex variety of pure dimension $d$ has an analytification that is a compact Hausdorff second-countable complex manifold of complex dimension $d$, a finite discrete set when $d=0$; every standard smooth algebraic chart becomes a holomorphic chart and every morphism of smooth complex varieties induces a holomorphic, hence continuous, map. The analytic topology of a complex algebraic variety is the one of the cited definition, and regular maps are continuous for it.
